setting.password.help: The WebSocket server password, from step 4.
step.1: Open OBS Studio. From version 28 on, WebSocket comes built in, nothing to install.
step.3: Check **Enable WebSocket server**. You can keep port 4455.
step.4: Click **Show Connect Info** and copy the server password.
step.5: Turn on the integration here and paste it into Password. If OBS runs on another PC, put its IP in Address; on the same PC, keep localhost.
step.6: Done: the status up here changes to Connected. The app reconnects on its own whenever OBS opens.
